Holistic Enrichment

Our Activities

A rich variety of hands-on activities designed to engage, delight and develop every dimension of your child.

Art and Craft

Children explore colors, textures and tactile materials through hands-on creative crafts and finger painting.

Activity 1

Music and Dance

Joyful rhythms, nursery songs and creative movement activities develop rhythm, physical coordination and expression.

Activity 2

Storytelling

Enchanting picture-book sessions expand vocabulary, spark imagination and cultivate an enduring love for books.

Activity 3

Outdoor Play

Fresh air, lawn games and playground obstacles develop balance, gross motor skills and active physical confidence.

Activity 4

Educational Games

Age-appropriate puzzles, shape matching, counting blocks and memory games build foundational logic without pressure.

Activity 5

Creative Learning

Open-ended sensory play, building blocks and pretend-play stations let children invent and explore their own ideas.

Activity 6

Group Activities

Collaborative play, circle conversations and sharing exercises help little ones build strong empathy and teamwork.

Activity 7

Celebration Activities

Festivals, cultural days, color days and themed events celebrate diversity and bring joyful memories to early childhood.

Activity 8
Routine & Rhythm

A Day at InnoTots

A glimpse into our balanced daily rhythm of joyful play, guided learning and mindful rest.

Note: Illustrative daily routine; specific timings are gently adapted per program age tier.
08:00 AM

Arrival & Warm Welcome

Children arrive, unpack their little bags, greet teachers and settle into morning free play corners.

08:30 AM

Circle Time & Rhymes

Morning gathering with welcome songs, weather wheel, calendar fun and joyful sharing time.

09:00 AM

Core Learning Activity

Structured, playful activities focused on phonics, numbers, shapes and sensory exploration.

09:45 AM

Healthy Snack Break

Social dining habits, table etiquette and nutritious refreshment shared with classmates.

10:15 AM

Creative Expression & Art

Hands-on painting, clay molding, music and sensory building activities.

11:00 AM

Outdoor Physical Play

Free movement, jungle gym, balance beam and cooperative outdoor playground games.

11:45 AM

Story Time & Mindfulness

Calming wind-down circle with picture books, quiet music and gentle reflection.

12:30 PM

Reflection & Farewell

Reviewing the day's happy moments, pack-up rituals and warm goodbyes with parents.
